function.name: generateRunwareImage
function.description: Generates an image using the Runware.ai API from a text prompt and displays it to the user in a resizable window that scales with the window. Returns the generated image URL, prompt, model, and size used. The control panel lets the user set the model and image size, defaulting to model "runware:100@1" and size 1024x1024.

prompt.description: The text prompt to use for image generation.
